actions.label: Restart workloads
actions.description: Restart the Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet behind a problem.
actions.effect: May set the restartedAt annotation on the affected workload, like kubectl rollout restart.

actions.label: Argo CD: sync
actions.description: Sync an app that is out of sync.
actions.effect: May start a sync of the affected Argo CD app (a patch of its operation field).

actions.label: Argo CD: hard refresh
actions.description: Re-read an app's state from Git.
actions.effect: May set the annotation argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard on the affected app.

actions.label: CloudNativePG: backup
actions.description: Start an overdue backup right away.
actions.effect: May create one Backup object for the affected database cluster.

actions.label: Read logs
actions.description: Show the last lines of a crashed pod.
actions.effect: Only reads the last 300 lines of the pod an issue names; changes nothing.
